description: Return public DirectMailAmerica website sign-in, developer settings and MCP documentation links when the user requests account connection help. No charge, inputs or authentication required. This is a link lookup only: it does not open a browser, start authentication, create an account, issue credentials, change permissions, or send mail. Website sign-in is separate from MCP authorization.
name: get_account_connection_links

outputSchema.description: Read operation first for financial/mail state and recovery. Optional service fields are absent on failure. Unknown is not zero or permission to retry. Legacy service fields remain available.

amountCents.description: USD cents. Null means not applicable or not known; never interpret null as zero.

title: Get account connection links
